value.rationale: Characterizes, with exact necessity and sufficiency, when two physically distinct quantum transport Hamiltonians are experimentally indistinguishable from every exterior start across an infinite continuous-weight family. Nonregular branch generalizes an explicitly proposed but numerically supported unweighted family and is sharply separated from the trivial regular branch. A single-site fourth-order time coefficient tests an all-time many-site condition, useful for design and diagnosis of weighted couplings.
